newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's CCP-dollar rate dips in March vs February.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's CCP-dollar rate dips in March vs February.

text.p: Mexico's CCP-dollar rate, the average bank term desposit cost measured in dollars, was 6.72 percent in March, compared with 6.75 percent in February, Banco de Mexico said Monday.
The central bank said that the rate can be used as a reference to determine the interest rate of credits denominated in dollars.
The monthly calculation of the CCP-dollars includes loans of foreign banks to multiple banking institutions, and financing received from various export and import development banks.
